Definition: to be new; causatively, to rebuild
BiblicalUsage: Chadash means to be new, to renew, to rebuild. Samuel called Israel to Gilgal to renew the kingdom, Asa renewed the altar of the LORD, Job complained that God renewed His witnesses against him, and David prayed, Create in me a clean heart, and renew a right spirit within me.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe renewal is God's trade: He renews kingdoms and altars and spirits, and even Job's complaint is answered by it. The only renewal that lasts is the one David asked for — a right spirit, made new inside.
RelatedEvents: David and Bathsheba; Saul Rescues Jabesh-Gilead
